books.identification_note: Contents match Hal Leonard's SMTA Volume 2, Mezzo-Soprano/Belter (Richard Walters, ed.): belt-heavy mezzo repertoire including 'If He Walked Into My Life', 'Everything's Coming Up Roses', 'Rose's Turn', 'When You're Good to Mama', 'Don't Rain on My Parade', and the page ordering (159–268) of 'Miss Marmelstein', 'Someone Like You', 'Stars and the Moon', 'My New Philosophy'. Voice type/volume confirmed by tracklist; book id left unchanged.
